defs.def: to think or believe that sth will happen or that sb will do sth 预料；预期；预计

ex.s: They absorb less carbon than expected.
ex.t: 它们吸收的碳比预期的少。

ex.s: I breathed a huge sigh of relief: I had expected sadness, maybe even doubt, but Dad was already looking to the future.
ex.t: 我长长地松了一口气：我本以为会是伤感，甚至可能是疑虑，但爸爸已经在展望未来。

ex.s: What are the volunteers expected to do?
ex.t: 志愿者需要做什么？

ex.s: This is why Campbell has set out to raise awareness of AI and its future now — several decades before these developments are expected to take place.
ex.t: 这就是为什么坎贝尔现在就开始提高人们对人工智能及其未来的认识——比这些发展预计发生的时间早了几十年。

ex.s: What are the students expected to do?
ex.t: 学生们需要做什么？

ex.s: I hadn’t expected I’d be standing there that morning.
ex.t: 我那天早上没想到自己会站在那里。

ex.s: They reached the shooting spot later than expected.
ex.t: 他们到达射击地点的时间比预期的晚。

ex.s: Naturally, you would expect the addition of the errors to have increased unwanted confusion.
ex.t: 类似的研究也被用来理解当我们欣赏令人印象深刻的雕塑、有吸引力的面孔、精彩的舞蹈等时产生的"神经元烟花"。

ex.s: What function is expected of the rail drones?
ex.t: 期望铁路无人机具备什么功能？

ex.s: Initially the sugar tax was expected to make £520m a year for the Treasury.
ex.t: 最初，糖税预计每年为财政部带来5.2亿英镑的收入。

ex.s: At present it is expected to generate £240m for the year ending in April 2019, which will go to school sports.
ex.t: 目前预计到2019年4月截止的财政年度将产生2.4亿英镑的收入，这笔资金将用于学校体育。

ex.s: Once, a young woman, who was on her way to visit her family in South Africa, told me she was expecting her first baby.
ex.t: 一次，一位正要去南非探望家人的年轻女子告诉我，她怀上了第一个孩子。

ex.s: Applicants are expected to design furniture.
ex.t: 申请人应具备设计家具的能力。

ex.s: Organizers expected perhaps 50,000 people to show up.
ex.t: 组织者原本预计会有大约5万人到场。

ex.s: What can we expect of the glowing plants in the future?
ex.t: 未来我们可以期待发光植物什么？

ex.s: The median age of an American in 1950   56   （be） 30 -- today it is 41 and is expected   57   （increase） to 42 by 2050.
ex.t: 1950年美国人的年龄中位数___56___（be）30岁——今天是41岁，预计到2050年___57___（increase）到42岁。

ex.s: While cars and trains are moving towards greener, electric power, emissions from air travel are expected to increase massively by 2050.
ex.t: 虽然汽车和火车正朝着更环保、电动化的方向发展，但预计到2050年，航空旅行的排放量将大幅增加。

ex.s: What does Moore expect from her business?
ex.t: Moore期望从她的生意中获得什么？

ex.s: I decided to play with him with only one toy for as long as it would keep his interest I expected that one toy would keep his attention for about five minutes, ten minutes, max I chose a red rubber ball—simple, universally available.
ex.t: 我决定只用一个玩具陪他玩，只要还能吸引他的兴趣就行；我估计一个玩具大概能让他专注五分钟，最多十分钟。我选了一个红色的橡皮球——简单、随处可见。

ex.s: It’s expected to cost $279,000.
ex.t: 预计售价为27.9万美元。

ex.s: “For example, most of us would expect older drivers always go slower than everyone else but surprisingly, we found that in 30mph zones they struggled to keep at a constant speed and so were more likely to break the speed limit and be at risk of getting fined.
ex.t: “例如，我们大多数人都以为老年驾驶者总是比其他人开得慢，但令人惊讶的是，我们发现，在限速30英里每小时的区域，他们难以保持匀速，因此更有可能超速并被罚款的风险。

ex.s: It’s expected to cost $279,000.And it won’t help if you’re stuck in traffic.
ex.t: 它预计售价为279,000美元。而且如果你遇到交通堵塞，它也无济于事。

ex.s: As for the USA, it is almost unique among developed nations in having a population that is expected to grow by 20% from 2010—2030.
ex.t: 至于美国，在发达国家中它几乎独一无二，其人口预计在2010至2030年间增长20%。

defs.def: to be waiting for sb/sth to arrive, as this has been arranged 常用于进行时

ex.s: We didn't expect to get so many posts!
ex.t: 我们没想到会收到这么多帖子！

ex.s: Jean: I expect you are feeling tired now!
ex.t: 简：我想你现在一定感觉累了吧！

ex.s: The painting is a lot smaller than you would expect, and is protected by glass.
ex.t: 这幅画比你想象的要小得多，而且有玻璃保护着。

defs.def: to demand that sb will do sth because it is their duty or responsibility 要求；期望；指望

ex.s: In fact, in an interview, an important question to ask is: “ What would be expected of me as an employee?” In today's tough 'job market, young job seekers need to provide a potential employer with good reasons to hire them.
ex.t: 事实上，在面试中，一个要问的重要问题是：“作为雇员，我会被期望做什么？”在当今严峻的就业市场中，年轻的求职者需要向潜在雇主提供充分的理由来雇用他们。

ex.s: But she expects using the chemical in some kind of industrial process — not simply “millions of worms thrown on top of the plastic.”
ex.t: 但她期望将这种化学物质用于某种工业流程中——而不是简单地把“数百万条虫子扔在塑料上”。

ex.s: You can’t expect your child to tackle their tasks with enthusiasm while you’re complaining about loading the dishwasher.
ex.t: 你不能一边抱怨着把碗碟放进洗碗机，一边指望孩子满怀热情地完成自己的任务。

ex.s: Be demanding on yourself and expect 100 percent attention to the task.
ex.t: 对自己严格要求，期待百分之百的注意力投入到任务中。

ex.s: What is expected of a good ending?
ex.t: 一个好的结尾应具备什么？

ex.s: The researchers found that the dogs were able to pick the angry or happy face by touching a picture of it with their noses more often than one would expect by random chance.
ex.t: 研究人员发现，狗能够通过用鼻子触碰图片来选择愤怒或快乐的面孔，其正确率高于随机概率。

ex.s: In India, particularly outside cities, young women are expected to move in with their husband’s family when they get married.
ex.t: 在印度，特别是在城市以外，年轻女性结婚后 expected 要搬进去和丈夫的家人住在一起。

ex.s: What does Parry expect to achieve with his artworks?
ex.t: 帕里希望用他的艺术作品实现什么？

ex.s: What do the researchers expect of the smart keyboard？all 1o soisgitieoco oll.
ex.t: 研究人员对智能键盘有什么期望？所有10个soisgitieoco oll。

ex.s: Mabry works circles around all the students， cleaning up messes others don't want to touch． He doesn't expect a lot． Mabry said he hadn't planned to do much for his milestone birthday，so he was happy the students had prepared the surprise celebration．
ex.t: 马布里围着所有学生忙碌，清理别人不愿碰的脏乱。他要求不多。马布里说他原本没有打算为这个里程碑式的生日做什么，所以学生们准备了这场惊喜庆祝活动，他很高兴。

ex.s: But don’t expect it to show up in too many driveways.
ex.t: 但不要指望它会在太多车道上出现。

ex.s: But don’t expect it to show up in too many driveways.
ex.t: 但不要指望它会在太多车道上出现。

ex.s: How would you expect others to truly understand your emotions if you only shared good news instead of bad?
ex.t: 如果你只分享好消息而不是坏消息，你怎能指望别人真正理解你的情绪呢？
